PC: Review of past medical history and intra-operative record
Alternate method for oxygen administration (i.e.- face mask, non-rebreather mask)
Begin mask ventilation (utilize oral/nasal airways as appropriate)
Begin cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR): chest compressions, defibrillation, medications
MK: Consider differential diagnosis for acute respiratory insufficiency
Discuss results of arterial blood gas (ABG)
SBP: Ask for respiratory therapist (RT) assistance (if available)
Prepare patient for return to operating room
ICS: Discussion with recovery room nurse regarding events leading up to current state
Communicate with nurse the plan for re-intubation
